summary: Iteration 11 - Single-admin session, payment method dropdown (Contanti/Bonifico), Cancel safety, sidebar reorder + Stanze removal, notification badge. Backend pytest 13/13 passed. Frontend Playwright validated all sidebar/dialog flows.
action_items: (Carry-over from iter 10) Add unique compound index on monthly_status(tenant_id, month, year).
(Carry-over) Batch-load monthly_status in /late-tenants and /dashboard/stats to reduce N+1.
(Carry-over) DELETE /api/payment-calendar should return 404 when no override exists.
(Carry-over) Add ESC-to-close to TenantDetail edit-month dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login_direct: SINGLE-ADMIN enforcement uses update_many({'is_active': True}, ...) on EVERY successful login - including when the SAME admin re-logs in. This kills the user's own previous tabs unintentionally. Consider scoping by admin_id != current to allow same-admin multi-tab.

auth.py: ADMIN1_PASSWORD/ADMIN2_PASSWORD env vars must contain literal '$' characters (bcrypt hashes start with $2b$). Verify .env doesn't shell-expand them - here only plaintext passwords are stored in .env, hashed at startup, so this is safe. Confirmed.

notifications_routes.py /notifications/count duplicates the late-detection logic from payment_calendar._compute_month_status and dashboard.py - 4 different places now compute 'is late'. Extract a shared helper to avoid drift.
Layout.js: notifCount polling uses fetch every 60s with no abort on unmount race - on rapid navigation can set state on unmounted component. Minor.
AuthContext.js session-check kick UX uses window.alert() (synchronous, blocks event loop). Replace with toast or modal for better UX consistency.
TenantDetail.js edit dialog is a custom fixed overlay (not Radix Dialog). No ESC handling, no focus trap.
Tenants.js handleQuickStatusChange: when newStatus='not_paid'/'late', it triggers full fetchAll() reload instead of optimistic UI update.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Test creates monthly_status override for 2026/04 then deletes it. Single-admin kick test logs both admins in/out, leaving admin1 as the final active session.

verification_details.single_admin_kick: Verified: when admin2 logs in, admin1's prior session-check returns 401. Then admin1 logs in -> admin2's session-check returns 401. Layout.js polls /api/auth/session-check every 30s and shows window.alert + setUser(false) when 401 received.
verification_details.session_check: GET /api/auth/session-check returns {valid:true, email} for authenticated, 401 for unauthenticated. Used by AuthContext.js polling.
verification_details.notification_count: GET /api/notifications/count returns {count: int}. Layout.js shows red badge with count next to 'Notifiche' menu item when count>0. Verified live UI badge showed '5'.
verification_details.payment_calendar_due_day: GET /api/payment-calendar/{tid}?year=2026 returns {tenant_id, year, due_day, calendar:[12]}. due_day from active contract (falls back to tenant.payment_due_day).
verification_details.payment_calendar_put: PUT with status=paid/not_paid/late all return 200 and persist. Invalid status -> 400. Override visible via subsequent GET (manual_override=true).
verification_details.sidebar_order: Verified live: ['Proprietari','Immobili','Inquilini','Dashboard','Pagamenti','Ospitalità','Registrazione','Contratti','Fatture','Notifiche5','Report','Gestione Dati']. No Stanze item.
verification_details.tenants_quick_dialog: Clicking status badge (testid status-btn-{id}) for not_paid/late tenant opens dialog with Contanti/Bonifico method buttons + Importo input + Annulla/Conferma. Annulla just closes dialog (no API call). Confirmed via UI.
verification_details.tenant_detail_dialog: Clicking calendar-month-{n} opens dialog with set-month-not_paid, set-month-late buttons (each fires its own PUT immediately) and a Paid section with Contanti/Bonifico method buttons + amount input + 'Conferma Pagamento' (testid set-month-paid) which fires PUT with payment_method. Annulla (testid cancel-edit-month) closes dialog with NO API call.
verification_details.dashboard_links: Dashboard renders <Link to='/tenants?status=paid'>{count}</Link>, <Link to='/tenants?status=not_paid'>{count}</Link>, <Link to='/tenants?status=late'>{count}</Link>. Numbers are clickable. 'Inquilini In Ritardo — {month}' luxury card renders with red rows linking to /tenants/{id}.
